title: Redeeming Customer Loyalty Points on POS Counter (F8)

intro.title: POS Loyalty Points Redemption
intro.subtitle: Customer points balance check, one-click Redeem Max, bill discounts, and automatic audit reconciliation

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 2, Part 18: Redeeming Customer Loyalty Points on the POS Counter. Rewarding returning patients builds trust, drives customer retention, and increases lifetime basket value.
When billing, select a registered patient in the Customer picker. MediFlow instantly verifies and displays their active loyalty points and rupee redemption value on screen.
Press F8 or click Split Tender to open the settlement panel. Under Loyalty Points, enter the points to redeem or simply click Redeem Max to apply the full eligible discount.
The bill total updates instantly. MediFlow protects the transaction with row-level balance verification, logs an audited redeem event, and prints redeemed points directly on the receipt.
And if a bill is ever cancelled or returned, customer reward points are automatically restored! Congratulations on completing Phase 2: POS Counter Mastery!

outro.takeaway: POS Loyalty Redemption: Check live customer balances, apply instant bill discounts with Redeem Max, and ensure automatic point restoration on bill reversals.
